name: Ajka (Hungary)
description: Dark purple field charged at the centre with the town arms of Ajka: a blue and green shield with a miner, with a helm, an eagle crest and grey and red mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ajka arms with helm, crest and mantling
